q: अंगुत्तर निकाय जैसे बौद्ध ग्रंथों में वर्णित 16 प्राचीन महाजनपदों में से कितने पूर्णतः या आंशिक रूप से वर्तमान उत्तर प्रदेश में स्थित थे?
e: Eight of the 16 Mahajanapadas lay in present-day Uttar Pradesh: Kashi, Kosala, Vatsa, Malla, Kuru, Panchala, Shurasena, and Chedi. | 16 महाजनपदों में से 8 महाजनपद वर्तमान उत्तर प्रदेश में स्थित थे—काशी, कोसल, वत्स, मल्ल, कुरु, पांचाल, शूरसेन और चेदि। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Capital of Kashi was Varanasi and Kosala was Shravasti/Saketa. (2) Vatsa's capital was Kaushambi (Prayagraj region) and Shurasena's capital was Mathura. (3) Malla was a republic (Gana-Sangha) with capitals at Kushinara and Pava. (4) Panchala had Ahichhatra (Bareilly) and Kampilya (Farrukhabad) as northern and southern capitals.
qe: Out of the 16 ancient Mahajanapadas mentioned in Buddhist texts like Anguttara Nikaya, how many were located wholly or partly in present-day Uttar Pradesh?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के किस स्थान पर गौतम बुद्ध ने अपना प्रथम उपदेश दिया था, जिसे धर्मचक्र प्रवर्तन कहा जाता है?
e: Gautam Buddha delivered his first sermon to five ascetics at Rishipatana (Deer Park / Mrigadava) in Sarnath near Varanasi. | गौतम बुद्ध ने अपना प्रथम उपदेश वाराणसी के समीप सारनाथ (ऋषिपत्तन/मृगदाव) में पाँच संन्यासियों को दिया था। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Dhamekh Stupa and Ashoka's Lion Capital (India's National Emblem) are located at Sarnath. (2) Buddha attained Mahaparinirvana at Kushinagar (Malla republic). (3) Buddha spent the maximum number of rainy seasons (Varshavas) and delivered the most sermons at Shravasti (Jetavana Vihara). (4) Sankissa (Farrukhabad) is believed to be where Buddha descended from Tavatimsa heaven.
qe: At which place in Uttar Pradesh did Gautam Buddha deliver his first sermon, known as Dharmachakra Pravartana?

q: 1857 का विद्रोह औपचारिक रूप से 10 मई 1857 को उत्तर प्रदेश के किस छावनी नगर से प्रारंभ हुआ था?
e: Sepoys of the 3rd Native Cavalry at Meerut Cantonment rose in rebellion on 10 May 1857 and marched to Delhi the next day. | मेरठ छावनी की 3rd नेटिव कैवेलरी के सैनिकों ने 10 मई 1857 को विद्रोह प्रारंभ किया और दिल्ली की ओर कूच किया। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Mangal Pandey belonged to Ballia (UP) and served in the 34th Bengal Native Infantry at Barrackpore. (2) Kotwal Dhan Singh Gurjar played a key leadership role in Meerut during May 1857. (3) The 1857 uprising is commemorated at Shaheed Smarak in Meerut. (4) Queen Victoria's Proclamation transferring power to the British Crown was read by Lord Canning at Allahabad (Prayagraj) on 1 November 1858.
qe: The Revolt of 1857 formally began on 10 May 1857 from which cantonment town of Uttar Pradesh?

q:
उत्तर प्रदेश के निम्नलिखित 1857 विद्रोह केंद्रों का उनके नेताओं से मिलान कीजिए:
1. लखनऊ — (i) बेगम हज़रत महल
2. कानपुर — (ii) नाना साहेब एवं तात्या टोपे
3. बरेली — (iii) खान बहादुर खान
4. फैज़ाबाद — (iv) मौलवी अहमदुल्लाह शाह
सही कूट चुनिए:
e: Begum Hazrat Mahal led Awadh (Lucknow), Nana Saheb and Tatya Tope led Kanpur, Khan Bahadur Khan led Rohilkhand (Bareilly), and Maulvi Ahmadullah Shah led Faizabad. | लखनऊ में बेगम हज़रत महल, कानपुर में नाना साहेब व तात्या टोपे, बरेली में खान बहादुर खान तथा फैज़ाबाद में मौलवी अहमदुल्लाह शाह ने नेतृत्व किया। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Rani Lakshmibai led Jhansi and fought Sir Hugh Rose; she was born in Varanasi as Manikarnika. (2) Liaquat Ali led the revolt in Allahabad (Prayagraj). (3) Sir Colin Campbell recaptured both Kanpur and Lucknow for the British. (4) Kunwar Singh of Jagdishpur also briefly captured Azamgarh in eastern UP.
qe:
Match the following 1857 Revolt centres in Uttar Pradesh with their respective leaders:
1. Lucknow — (i) Begum Hazrat Mahal
2. Kanpur — (ii) Nana Saheb & Tatya Tope
3. Bareilly — (iii) Khan Bahadur Khan
4. Faizabad — (iv) Maulvi Ahmadullah Shah
Select the correct code:

q: फतेहपुर सीकरी में कौन-सा मुगल स्मारक सम्राट अकबर द्वारा अपनी गुजरात विजय की स्मृति में बनवाया गया था?
e: Buland Darwaza (Gate of Magnificence), standing 54 metres high at the southern entrance of Jama Masjid in Fatehpur Sikri, was built by Akbar to celebrate his Gujarat victory. | फतेहपुर सीकरी में 54 मीटर ऊँचा बुलंद दरवाज़ा अकबर ने गुजरात विजय के उपलक्ष्य में बनवाया था। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Fatehpur Sikri (Agra district) was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1986. (2) Other UNESCO World Heritage Sites in UP are Agra Fort (1983) and Taj Mahal (1983). (3) The Tomb of Sufi saint Sheikh Salim Chishti in Fatehpur Sikri is built of white marble. (4) Akbar's tomb is located at Sikandra (Agra) and Itmad-ud-Daulah's tomb (first Pietra Dura monument) is in Agra.
qe: Which Mughal monument in Fatehpur Sikri was built by Emperor Akbar to commemorate his conquest of Gujarat?

q:
काकोरी ट्रेन एक्शन (1925) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: यह 9 अगस्त 1925 को लखनऊ के पास हुआ था और इसका आयोजन हिंदुस्तान रिपब्लिकन एसोसिएशन (HRA) ने किया था।
कथन II: राम प्रसाद बिस्मिल को गोरखपुर जेल में तथा अशफाकउल्ला खान को फैज़ाबाद (अयोध्या) जेल में फाँसी दी गई थी।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
o: न तो कथन I और न ही II
e: Both statements are correct. On 9 August 1925, HRA revolutionaries looted the 8 Down Saharanpur–Lucknow passenger train at Kakori. Bismil was hanged at Gorakhpur and Ashfaqulla Khan at Faizabad. | दोनों कथन सही हैं। 9 अगस्त 1925 को HRA के क्रांतिकारियों ने काकोरी में सरकारी खजाना लूटा; बिस्मिल को गोरखपुर तथा अशफाकउल्ला खान को फैज़ाबाद जेल में फाँसी दी गई। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Rajendra Lahiri was hanged in Gonda Jail and Roshan Singh in Naini (Prayagraj) Jail. (2) Chandrashekhar Azad evaded arrest at Kakori and later attained martyrdom at Alfred Park (now Azad Park), Prayagraj on 27 Feb 1931. (3) UP Government officially renamed 'Kakori Conspiracy' to 'Kakori Train Action' in August 2021. (4) HRA was founded in Kanpur in October 1924 by Sachindra Nath Sanyal, Bismil, and Jogesh Chatterjee.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the Kakori Train Action (1925):
Statement I: It took place on 9 August 1925 near Lucknow and was organized by the Hindustan Republican Association (HRA).
Statement II: Ram Prasad Bismil was hanged in Gorakhpur Jail, whereas Ashfaqulla Khan was hanged in Faizabad (Ayodhya) Jail.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

q: गोरखपुर जिले की ऐतिहासिक 'चौरी-चौरा' घटना के 100 वर्ष पूर्ण होने के उपलक्ष्य में उत्तर प्रदेश सरकार द्वारा शताब्दी महोत्सव किस वर्ष प्रारंभ किया गया था?
e: The Chauri Chaura incident occurred on 4 February 1922; its year-long centenary celebration began on 4 February 2021 (entering its 100th year) and concluded on 4 February 2022. | चौरी-चौरा घटना 4 फरवरी 1922 को हुई थी; इसका वर्ष-भर चलने वाला शताब्दी महोत्सव 4 फरवरी 2021 को प्रारंभ होकर 4 फरवरी 2022 को संपन्न हुआ। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Following the Chauri Chaura incident (22 policemen killed), Mahatma Gandhi suspended the Non-Cooperation Movement at Bardoli on 12 February 1922. (2) Gorakhpur is also famous for Gita Press (founded 1923) and Gorakhnath Temple. (3) Bhagwan Ahir was a prominent local leader associated with the Chauri Chaura protest. (4) The Indian National Congress held 9 sessions in UP (Allahabad 3, Lucknow 3, Banaras 1, Kanpur 1, Meerut 1).
qe: In which year was the historic 'Chauri Chaura' incident in Gorakhpur district commemorated with a centenary celebration by the Uttar Pradesh government, marking 100 years since the event?

q: निम्नलिखित में से किसने भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के 1925 के कानपुर अधिवेशन की अध्यक्षता की और कांग्रेस की प्रथम भारतीय महिला अध्यक्ष बनीं?
e: Sarojini Naidu presided over the 1925 Kanpur Session of the INC, becoming the first Indian woman President (Annie Besant was the first woman overall in 1917). | सरोजिनी नायडू ने 1925 के कानपुर कांग्रेस अधिवेशन की अध्यक्षता की और प्रथम भारतीय महिला अध्यक्ष बनीं। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Sarojini Naidu also became the first Governor of Uttar Pradesh (United Provinces) after Independence (1947–49). (2) Sucheta Kripalani was the first woman Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh (and of any Indian state, 1963–67). (3) Govind Ballabh Pant was the first Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh. (4) The 1946 Meerut Session of INC was presided over by J. B. Kripalani.
qe: Who among the following presided over the 1925 Kanpur Session of the Indian National Congress, becoming the first Indian woman President of the INC?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के प्राचीन पुरातात्विक स्थलों और उनके जिलों के निम्नलिखित युग्मों में से कौन-सा सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
e: Lahuradewa, famous for the earliest evidence of rice cultivation (~8000–9000 BCE) in the Indian subcontinent, is located in Sant Kabir Nagar district, not Saharanpur. | लहुरादेवा (भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप में कृषि/धान के प्राचीनतम साक्ष्य वाला स्थल) संत कबीर नगर जिले में स्थित है, सहारनपुर में नहीं। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Alamgirpur (Meerut) lies on the banks of the Hindon River (tributary of Yamuna). (2) Mahadaha, Sarai Nahar Rai, and Damdama are major Mesolithic sites in Pratapgarh district. (3) Sanauli (Baghpat) yielded famous Bronze Age chariots and royal burials. (4) Bhitargaon (Kanpur Dehat) houses one of the oldest surviving Gupta-era brick temples in India.
qe: Which of the following pairs of ancient archaeological sites in Uttar Pradesh and their districts is NOT correctly matched?

q: भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन (1942) के दौरान उत्तर प्रदेश के किस जिले में चित्तू पांडे के नेतृत्व में एक समानांतर 'जातीय सरकार' की स्थापना की गई थी?
e: Chittu Pandey ('Sher-e-Ballia') established a parallel National Government in Ballia in August 1942, freeing the district temporarily from British rule. | चित्तू पांडे ('शेर-ए-बलिया') ने अगस्त 1942 में बलिया में समानांतर राष्ट्रीय सरकार स्थापित की थी। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Ballia is the easternmost district of Uttar Pradesh and birthplace of Mangal Pandey and former PM Chandra Shekhar. (2) Other parallel governments during 1942 were formed at Tamluk (Bengal) and Satara (Maharashtra). (3) The Prayagraj Pillar Inscription (Prayag Prashasti) of Samudragupta was composed by Harishena and shifted from Kaushambi to Allahabad Fort by Akbar. (4) Sharqi rulers of Jaunpur built the Atala Masjid, earning Jaunpur the title 'Shiraz-e-Hind'.
qe: During the Quit India Movement (1942), in which district of Uttar Pradesh was a parallel 'Jatiya Sarkar' (National Government) established under the leadership of Chittu Pandey?

q: भारत का कौन-सा शास्त्रीय नृत्य उत्तर प्रदेश में उद्भवित हुआ और अवध के नवाबों के संरक्षण में फला-फूला?
e: Kathak is the sole classical dance form of North India and Uttar Pradesh, deeply enriched by Nawab Wajid Ali Shah of Awadh and legends like Pandit Birju Maharaj. | कथक उत्तर भारत व उत्तर प्रदेश का प्रमुख शास्त्रीय नृत्य है, जिसे अवध के नवाब वाजिद अली शाह व पं. बिरजू महाराज ने समृद्ध किया। Exam Booster Facts: (1) The three major gharanas of Kathak are Lucknow, Banaras, and Jaipur. (2) Pandit Birju Maharaj (Brijmohan Nath Mishra) belonged to the Kalka-Bindadin gharana of Lucknow and received the Padma Vibhushan (1986). (3) Rashtriya Kathak Sansthan is situated in Lucknow (established 1988–89). (4) Bhatkhande Sanskriti Vishwavidyalaya (formerly Bhatkhande Music Institute) is located in Lucknow (founded 1926).
qe: Which classical dance form of India originated and flourished in Uttar Pradesh under the patronage of the Nawabs of Awadh?

q: प्रसिद्ध 'चरकुला' लोक नृत्य, जिसमें महिलाएँ अपने सिर पर 108 जलते हुए दीपकों का बहुमंजिला पिरामिड रखकर नृत्य करती हैं, उत्तर प्रदेश के किस सांस्कृतिक क्षेत्र से संबंधित है?
e: Charkula is a traditional folk dance of the Braj region (Mathura–Vrindavan), performed especially on the third day after Holi to celebrate Radha's birth. | चरकुला ब्रज क्षेत्र (मथुरा-वृंदावन) का प्रसिद्ध लोक नृत्य है, जो होली के बाद राधा के जन्मोत्सव पर किया जाता है। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Other Braj folk traditions: Rasiya (folk song), Mayur Nritya, and Lathmar Holi (Barsana–Nandgaon). (2) Bundelkhand folk dances: Rai, Pai Danda, Dhuria, and Diwari (Baredi); Alha is its famous heroic ballad. (3) Purvanchal folk forms: Birha (folk song), Dhobia, Kaharwa, and Natwari dances. (4) Karma folk dance is performed by the Kharwar tribe in Sonbhadra and Mirzapur.
qe: The famous 'Charkula' folk dance, in which women balance a multi-tiered pyramid of 108 lighted oil lamps on their heads, belongs to which cultural region of Uttar Pradesh?

q: होली के बाद आयोजित होने वाला हिंदू-मुस्लिम सांस्कृतिक एकता का प्रतीक प्रसिद्ध 'नौचंदी मेला' उत्तर प्रदेश के किस जिले में प्रतिवर्ष लगता है?
e: Nauchandi Mela is held annually at Nauchandi Ground in Meerut starting on the second Sunday after Holi, celebrating both Chandi Devi Temple and Bale Miyan Dargah. | नौचंदी मेला प्रतिवर्ष होली के दूसरे रविवार से मेरठ में लगता है, जहाँ चंडी देवी मंदिर व बाले मियाँ की दरगाह दोनों की परंपरा जुड़ी है। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Dewa Sharif Mela (Waris Ali Shah) is held in Barabanki district. (2) Bateshwar Mela (famous camel & livestock fair) is held on the Yamuna banks in Agra district. (3) Dadri Mela (major cattle fair) is organized in Ballia district. (4) Shakumbhari Devi Mela is held in Saharanpur district.
qe: The famous 'Nauchandi Mela', a symbol of Hindu–Muslim cultural harmony held after Holi, is organized annually in which district of Uttar Pradesh?

q:
उत्तर प्रदेश की निम्नलिखित लोक संगीत/नाट्य शैलियों का उनके प्रमुख क्षेत्रों से मिलान कीजिए:
1. कजरी — (i) मिर्जापुर
2. आल्हा — (ii) बुंदेलखंड
3. बिरहा — (iii) पूर्वांचल
4. रसिया — (iv) ब्रज
सही कूट चुनिए:
e: Kajri (monsoon folk song) originated in Mirzapur, Alha (heroic ballad of Alha-Udal by Jagnik) belongs to Bundelkhand, Birha to Purvanchal, and Rasiya to Braj. | कजरी (वर्षा गीत) मिर्जापुर, आल्हा (वीर रस गीत) बुंदेलखंड, बिरहा पूर्वांचल तथा रसिया ब्रज क्षेत्र की प्रमुख लोक विधाएँ हैं। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Nautanki is the most popular folk theatre of Uttar Pradesh, with major centres at Hathras and Kanpur. (2) Sohar is a traditional childbirth folk song of Awadh and Purvanchal. (3) Chaiti and Hori are seasonal semi-classical/folk songs of Varanasi and eastern UP. (4) Sangeet Natak Akademi of UP (established 1963) is located in Lucknow.
qe:
Match the following folk music / theatre forms of Uttar Pradesh with their primary regions:
1. Kajri — (i) Mirzapur
2. Alha — (ii) Bundelkhand
3. Birha — (iii) Purvanchal
4. Rasiya — (iv) Braj
Select the correct code:

q: प्रसिद्ध शहनाई वादक उस्ताद बिस्मिल्लाह खान (भारत रत्न 2001) तथा तबला वादक पंडित किशन महाराज उत्तर प्रदेश के किस संगीत घराने के दिग्गज थे?
e: Ustad Bismillah Khan, Pandit Kishan Maharaj, Girija Devi ('Queen of Thumri'), and Pandit Ravi Shankar (sitar) are all iconic figures associated with the Banaras Gharana. | उस्ताद बिस्मिल्लाह खान, पं. किशन महाराज, गिरिजा देवी ('ठुमरी की रानी') तथा पं. रविशंकर बनारस घराने की महान विभूतियाँ हैं। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Kirana Gharana (Shamli/Muzaffarnagar) was founded by Ustad Abdul Karim Khan; Bharat Ratna Pandit Bhimsen Joshi belonged to Kirana Gharana. (2) Agra Gharana is renowned for Khayal and Dhrupad (Ustad Faiyaz Khan). (3) Rampur-Sahaswan Gharana is known for Ustad Inayat Hussain Khan and Ustad Rashid Khan. (4) Pandit Hari Prasad Chaurasia (flute) was born in Prayagraj (UP).
qe: Ustad Bismillah Khan (Bharat Ratna 2001), the legendary Shehnai maestro, and Pandit Kishan Maharaj (Tabla) were doyens of which music gharana of Uttar Pradesh?

q: 'सुलह-ए-कुल' (हिंदू-मुस्लिम एकता) महोत्सव उत्तर प्रदेश के किस नगर में प्रतिवर्ष मनाया जाता है?
e: Sulh-e-Kul Utsav is organized annually in Agra to promote Hindu–Muslim unity, inspired by Emperor Akbar's policy of universal tolerance. | सुलह-ए-कुल उत्सव प्रतिवर्ष आगरा में हिंदू-मुस्लिम एकता के प्रतीक के रूप में मनाया जाता है। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Taj Mahotsav is also celebrated every February at Shilpgram in Agra. (2) Kampil Mahotsav (Jain & cultural heritage) is held in Farrukhabad district. (3) Kans Vadh Mela is celebrated in Mathura (and Fatehpur Sikri) on Kartik Shukla Dashami. (4) Kalinjar Mahotsav is celebrated in Banda district near the historic Kalinjar Fort.
qe: The 'Sulh-e-Kul' (Universal Harmony) festival is celebrated annually in which city of Uttar Pradesh?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के निम्नलिखित मेलों और उनके आयोजन जिलों में से कौन-सा सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
e: The grand 'Ram Barat' festival (part of Ramlila) is famously celebrated in Agra (Janakpuri), not Varanasi. | भव्य 'राम बारात' उत्सव आगरा में प्रसिद्ध रूप से मनाया जाता है, वाराणसी में नहीं। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Maha Kumbh is held every 12 years at Prayagraj (Triveni Sangam); UNESCO inscribed Kumbh Mela on its Intangible Cultural Heritage list in 2017. (2) Naimisharanya (88,000 Rishis' Tapobhoomi) and Parikrama Mela are located in Sitapur district. (3) Devipatan Mela is held at Tulsipur in Balrampur district. (4) Dhrupad Mela is organized annually at Tulsi Ghat in Varanasi and in Vrindavan.
qe: Which of the following fairs of Uttar Pradesh and its host district is NOT correctly matched?

q:
उत्तर प्रदेश के सांस्कृतिक संस्थानों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: भारतीय कला व पुरातत्व का प्रसिद्ध संग्रहालय 'भारत कला भवन' काशी हिंदू विश्वविद्यालय (वाराणसी) में स्थित है।
कथन II: भारतेंदु नाट्य अकादमी प्रयागराज में स्थित है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
o: न तो कथन I और न ही II
e: Statement I is correct (Bharat Kala Bhavan was founded in 1920 by Rai Krishnadasa at BHU, Varanasi). Statement II is incorrect because Bharatendu Natya Akademi (founded 1975) is located in Lucknow, not Prayagraj. | कथन I सही है (भारत कला भवन, बीएचयू वाराणसी में है)। कथन II गलत है क्योंकि भारतेंदु नाट्य अकादमी (स्थापना 1975) लखनऊ में स्थित है। Exam Booster Facts: (1) State Lalit Kala Akademi (1962) and UP Hindi Sansthan (1976) are in Lucknow. (2) North Central Zone Cultural Centre (NCZCC) is located in Prayagraj. (3) Motilal Nehru Bal Sangrahalaya (1957) is situated in Lucknow. (4) Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Library and Museum is located in Rampur (home to Raza Library too).
qe:
Consider the following statements about cultural institutions in Uttar Pradesh:
Statement I: Bharat Kala Bhavan, a renowned museum of Indian art and archaeology, is located inside Banaras Hindu University (Varanasi).
Statement II: Bharatendu Natya Akademi is situated in Prayagraj.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

q: हिंदुस्तानी शास्त्रीय संगीत के किराना घराने के संस्थापक कौन थे, जिसका नाम उत्तर प्रदेश के कैराना कस्बे से पड़ा है?
e: Ustad Abdul Karim Khan (along with Ustad Abdul Wahid Khan) established and popularized the Kirana Gharana, named after Kairana in Shamli district of Uttar Pradesh. | उस्ताद अब्दुल करीम खान ने शामली जिले के कैराना कस्बे से जुड़े किराना घराने की स्थापना व लोकप्रियता में प्रमुख भूमिका निभाई। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Famous vocalists of Kirana Gharana include Pandit Bhimsen Joshi, Gangubai Hangal, and Prabha Atre. (2) Pandit Ram Sahai founded the Banaras Tabla Gharana. (3) Amir Khusrau, born in Patiali (Kasganj, UP), is credited with inventing the Sitar, Tabla, and Khayal/Qawwali styles. (4) Swami Haridas (guru of Tansen) belonged to Vrindavan/Aligarh region and pioneered Dhrupad-Dhamar.
qe: Who was the founder of the Kirana Gharana of Hindustani classical music, which derives its name from Kairana town in Uttar Pradesh?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश अपनी सीमा क्रमशः कितने भारतीय राज्यों और केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों के साथ साझा करता है?
e: Uttar Pradesh borders 8 Indian states (Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Haryana, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Bihar), 1 Union Territory (Delhi), and 1 country (Nepal). | उत्तर प्रदेश की सीमा 8 राज्यों, 1 केंद्र शासित प्रदेश (दिल्ली) तथा 1 देश (नेपाल) से लगती है। Exam Booster Facts: (1) UP has 75 districts grouped into 18 administrative divisions (mandals). (2) Sonbhadra is the only district in India touching 4 states: MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, and Bihar. (3) Saharanpur borders 3 states: Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, and Haryana. (4) Lalitpur district is surrounded on three sides by Madhya Pradesh; UP shares its longest border with MP and shortest with Himachal Pradesh.
qe: Uttar Pradesh shares its boundary with how many Indian States and Union Territories respectively?

q: कौन-सी नदी उत्तर प्रदेश में बिजनौर जिले से प्रवेश करती है और बलिया जिले से बाहर निकलती है?
e: The Ganga enters Uttar Pradesh at Bijnor, flows across 28 districts of the state, and exits into Bihar from Ballia district. | गंगा नदी उत्तर प्रदेश में बिजनौर जिले से प्रवेश करती है, राज्य के 28 जिलों से बहती है और बलिया से बिहार में प्रवेश करती है। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Yamuna enters UP at Saharanpur (Faizabad) and merges with Ganga at Triveni Sangam in Prayagraj. (2) Gomti is a plains-fed river originating from Fulhar Lake (Gomat Taal) in Pilibhit and joining Ganga at Saidpur (Ghazipur). (3) Betwa and Ken are right-bank tributaries of Yamuna flowing through Bundelkhand. (4) Chambal joins Yamuna in Etawah district and is famous for ravines (beehad) and Gharial conservation.
qe: Which river enters Uttar Pradesh through Bijnor district and exits through Ballia district?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश को आधिकारिक रूप से कितने कृषि-जलवायु क्षेत्रों (Agro-Climatic Zones) में विभाजित किया गया है?
e: Uttar Pradesh is divided into 9 Agro-Climatic Zones based on rainfall, soil, temperature, and water availability. | वर्षा, मृदा, तापमान और जल उपलब्धता के आधार पर उत्तर प्रदेश को 9 कृषि-जलवायु क्षेत्रों में बाँटा गया है। Exam Booster Facts: (1) The 9 zones are Bhabhar & Tarai, Western Plain, Mid-Western Plain, South-Western Semi-Arid, Central Plain, Bundelkhand, North-Eastern Plain, Eastern Plain, and Vindhyan. (2) UP has 3 major physiographic regions: Bhabhar-Tarai, Gangetic Plain, and Southern Plateau (Bundelkhand/Vindhyan). (3) UP receives the highest rainfall in Gorakhpur and the lowest rainfall in Mathura. (4) UP leads India in total foodgrain, wheat, sugarcane, potato, and milk production.
qe: Into how many Agro-Climatic Zones (कृषि-जलवायु क्षेत्र) is Uttar Pradesh officially divided?

q:
उत्तर प्रदेश के निम्नलिखित पक्षी अभयारण्यों/रामसर आर्द्रभूमियों का उनके जिलों से मिलान कीजिए:
1. नवाबगंज पक्षी अभयारण्य — (i) उन्नाव
2. सूर सरोवर (कीठम झील) — (ii) आगरा
3. पार्वती अरगा पक्षी अभयारण्य — (iii) गोंडा
4. समन पक्षी अभयारण्य — (iv) मैनपुरी
सही कूट चुनिए:
e: Nawabganj (Shaheed Chandra Shekhar Azad) Bird Sanctuary is in Unnao, Sur Sarovar in Agra, Parvati Arga in Gonda, and Saman in Mainpuri—all four are Ramsar wetlands. | नवाबगंज (उन्नाव), सूर सरोवर (आगरा), पार्वती अरगा (गोंडा) तथा समन पक्षी अभयारण्य (मैनपुरी)—ये चारों रामसर स्थल हैं। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Nawabganj (1984) is the oldest bird sanctuary in UP. (2) Lakh Bahosi Bird Sanctuary (Kannauj) is the largest bird sanctuary in UP, while Patna Bird Sanctuary (Etah) is the smallest. (3) Other Ramsar sites in UP include Upper Ganga River (Brijghat–Narora, first in UP), Sandi (Hardoi), Samaspur (Raebareli), Sarsai Nawar (Etawah), Haiderpur (Muzaffarnagar–Bijnor), and Bakhira (Sant Kabir Nagar). (4) UP has 10 Ramsar sites in total.
qe:
Match the following Bird Sanctuaries / Ramsar Wetlands of Uttar Pradesh with their respective districts:
1. Nawabganj Bird Sanctuary — (i) Unnao
2. Sur Sarovar (Keetham Lake) — (ii) Agra
3. Parvati Arga Bird Sanctuary — (iii) Gonda
4. Saman Bird Sanctuary — (iv) Mainpuri
Choose the correct code:

q: बुंदेलखंड क्षेत्र में 2022 में अधिसूचित उत्तर प्रदेश का चौथा बाघ अभयारण्य (Tiger Reserve) निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा है?
e: Ranipur Tiger Reserve in Chitrakoot district (Bundelkhand) was notified as UP's 4th Tiger Reserve (and India's 53rd) in October 2022. | चित्रकूट जिले (बुंदेलखंड) में स्थित रानीपुर टाइगर रिज़र्व अक्टूबर 2022 में उत्तर प्रदेश का चौथा (तथा भारत का 53वाँ) टाइगर रिज़र्व बना। Exam Booster Facts: (1) UP's 4 Tiger Reserves are Dudhwa (Lakhimpur Kheri), Pilibhit (Pilibhit–Shahjahanpur), Amangarh (Bijnor, buffer of Corbett), and Ranipur (Chitrakoot). (2) Dudhwa National Park (1977) is the only National Park in Uttar Pradesh and is famous for Barasingha (swamp deer). (3) Pilibhit Tiger Reserve won the TX2 International Award for doubling its tiger population. (4) Terai Elephant Reserve (India's 33rd) spans Dudhwa–Pilibhit in UP.
qe: Which of the following is the 4th Tiger Reserve of Uttar Pradesh, notified in 2022 in the Bundelkhand region?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश की कौन-सी प्रमुख नदी-घाटी बांध परियोजना सोनभद्र जिले में रिहंद नदी (सोन की सहायक) पर निर्मित है, जिससे गोविंद बल्लभ पंत सागर झील बनी है?
e: Rihand Dam (Pipri, Sonbhadra) impounds Govind Ballabh Pant Sagar, India's largest artificial lake by volume. | रिहंद बांध (पिपरी, सोनभद्र) द्वारा निर्मित गोविंद बल्लभ पंत सागर आयतन के अनुसार भारत की सबसे बड़ी कृत्रिम झील है। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Matatila Dam, Rajghat Dam (UP–MP joint project), and Parichha Dam are all located on the Betwa River. (2) Ramganga Dam (Kalagarh) is in Bijnor district. (3) Sharda Canal is the longest canal system in Uttar Pradesh, while Eastern Yamuna Canal (1830) is the oldest. (4) Arjun Sahayak Irrigation Project benefits Mahoba, Banda, and Hamirpur in Bundelkhand.
qe: Which major river-valley dam project in Uttar Pradesh is built on the Rihand River (a tributary of Son) in Sonbhadra district, creating Govind Ballabh Pant Sagar?

q: भौगोलिक क्षेत्रफल की दृष्टि से उत्तर प्रदेश का सबसे बड़ा जिला और सबसे छोटा जिला क्रमशः कौन-से हैं?
e: Lakhimpur Kheri (7,680 sq km) is the largest district of UP by area, while Hapur (660 sq km) is the smallest district by area. | क्षेत्रफल की दृष्टि से लखीमपुर खीरी (7,680 वर्ग किमी) सबसे बड़ा तथा हापुड़ (660 वर्ग किमी) उत्तर प्रदेश का सबसे छोटा जिला है। Exam Booster Facts: (1) UP's total geographical area is 2,40,928 sq km (7.33% of India's area), ranking 4th among Indian states after Rajasthan, MP, and Maharashtra. (2) Extreme districts of UP: Northernmost—Saharanpur, Southernmost—Sonbhadra, Easternmost—Ballia, Westernmost—Shamli. (3) Highest forest cover percentage in UP is in Sonbhadra district, and lowest in Bhadohi. (4) UP's state tree is Ashoka, state flower Palash, state bird Sarus Crane, and state animal Barasingha.
qe: Which district of Uttar Pradesh has the largest geographical area, and which has the smallest geographical area respectively?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश में निर्माणाधीन 'गंगा एक्सप्रेसवे' किन दो नगरों को अपने पश्चिमी और पूर्वी छोर के रूप में जोड़ता है?
e: The 594 km greenfield Ganga Expressway connects Meerut (Bijauli village) to Prayagraj (Judapur Dandu village) across 12 districts of UP. | 594 किमी लंबा गंगा एक्सप्रेसवे उत्तर प्रदेश के 12 जिलों से गुजरते हुए मेरठ को प्रयागराज से जोड़ता है। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Purvanchal Expressway (341 km) connects Lucknow (Chand Sarai) to Ghazipur (Haidaria). (2) Bundelkhand Expressway (296 km) connects Chitrakoot (Bharatkup) to Etawah (Kudrail on Agra–Lucknow Expressway). (3) Agra–Lucknow Expressway (302 km) and Yamuna Expressway (165 km, Greater Noida–Agra) are operational. (4) UP is India's leading 'Expressway Pradesh' with multiple operational airstrips on expressways for IAF emergency landings.
qe: The 'Ganga Expressway', under construction across Uttar Pradesh, connects which two cities as its western and eastern termini?

q:
उत्तर प्रदेश की मृदा और कृषि के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: 'भोंटा' और 'मार' (काली चिकनी) मृदा उत्तर प्रदेश के बुंदेलखंड क्षेत्र में प्रमुख रूप से पाई जाती है।
कथन II: उत्तर प्रदेश का प्रतापगढ़ जिला भारत में आँवला का अग्रणी उत्पादक है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
o: न तो कथन I और न ही II
e: Both statements are correct. Bundelkhand features Red, Parwa, Mar (black), Rakar, and Bhonta soils, and Pratapgarh is renowned as the 'Amla City' of India. | दोनों कथन सही हैं। बुंदेलखंड में मार, पड़वा, राकर व भोंटा मृदा पाई जाती है, तथा प्रतापगढ़ आँवला उत्पादन में देश में अग्रणी है। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Malihabad (Lucknow) is world-famous for Dussehri mangoes; Rataul mango (Baghpat) and Langra mango (Varanasi) hold GI tags. (2) Kala Namak Rice (Siddharthnagar) holds a GI tag and is known as 'Buddha's gift'. (3) Barabanki is the leading producer of opium (poppy) in UP, and Ghazipur hosts the Government Opium and Alkaloid Works. (4) UP's first Agricultural University was Govind Ballabh Pant University (1960, now in Uttarakhand); today UP has CSA (Kanpur), ANDUAT (Ayodhya), SVPUAT (Meerut), and BUAT (Banda).
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding soils and agriculture in Uttar Pradesh:
Statement I: 'Bhonta' and 'Mar' (black clay) soils are predominantly found in the Bundelkhand region of Uttar Pradesh.
Statement II: Pratapgarh district of Uttar Pradesh is India's leading producer of Amla (Indian gooseberry).
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के निम्नलिखित वन्यजीव अभयारण्यों और उनके जिलों में से कौन-सा सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
e: Hastinapur Wildlife Sanctuary (the largest wildlife sanctuary in UP, ~2,073 sq km) spans Meerut, Muzaffarnagar, Hapur, Amroha, and Bijnor districts—not Jhansi. | हस्तिनापुर वन्यजीव अभयारण्य (उत्तर प्रदेश का सबसे बड़ा वन्यजीव अभयारण्य) मेरठ-मुजफ्फरनगर-बिजनौर आदि जिलों में विस्तृत है, झाँसी में नहीं। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Chandra Prabha (1957, Chandauli) is the oldest wildlife sanctuary in Uttar Pradesh. (2) Mahavir Swami Wildlife Sanctuary (Lalitpur) is the smallest wildlife sanctuary in UP. (3) National Chambal Sanctuary (Agra–Etawah) protects Gharials and Gangetic Dolphins. (4) Jatayu Conservation and Breeding Centre (for red-headed vultures) is established in Maharajganj district.
qe: Which of the following Wildlife Sanctuaries of Uttar Pradesh and its district is NOT correctly matched?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश की प्रमुख 'एक जिला एक उत्पाद' (ODOP) योजना के अंतर्गत कौन-सा जिला अपने धातु शिल्प हेतु 'पीतल नगरी' के रूप में प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Moradabad is globally famous as 'Pital Nagari' (Brass City) and its ODOP product is Metal Craft (Brassware). | मुरादाबाद को विश्व स्तर पर 'पीतल नगरी' कहा जाता है और इसका ODOP उत्पाद धातु शिल्प (पीतल के बर्तन) है। Exam Booster Facts: (1) UP's ODOP scheme was launched on 24 January 2018 (Uttar Pradesh Diwas). (2) Firozabad is famous for Glassware/Bangles ('Suhag Nagari'), Aligarh for Locks & Hardware, and Kannauj for Ittar (Perfume). (3) Bhadohi (Sant Ravidas Nagar) and Mirzapur are famous for Handmade Carpets. (4) Meerut is known as 'Sports City' for its sports goods ODOP.
qe: Under Uttar Pradesh's flagship 'One District One Product' (ODOP) scheme, which district is famously known as 'Pital Nagari' (Brass City) for its metalcraft?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा जिला राज्य में पाए गए यूरेनियम भंडार का एकमात्र उत्पादक क्षेत्र है?
e: Uranium deposits in Uttar Pradesh are found exclusively in Lalitpur district (along with rock phosphate and copper in the Sonrai area). | उत्तर प्रदेश में यूरेनियम के भंडार केवल ललितपुर जिले में पाए जाते हैं। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Sonbhadra is the richest mineral district of UP (coal at Singrauli, limestone, dolomite, marble, bauxite). (2) Silica sand (glass sand) is abundant in Shankargarh/Lohgara (Prayagraj) and Chitrakoot. (3) Diamond deposits occur in Banda and Mirzapur districts. (4) Non-plastic fireclay is found in Bansi-Makrikhoh (Mirzapur) and gypsum in Jhansi–Hamirpur.
qe: Which district of Uttar Pradesh is the sole producer of Uranium deposits discovered in the state?

q: भारतीय दलहन अनुसंधान संस्थान (IIPR) उत्तर प्रदेश में कहाँ स्थित है?
e: The Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR) is located in Kalyanpur, Kanpur. | भारतीय दलहन अनुसंधान संस्थान (IIPR) कानपुर में स्थित है। Exam Booster Facts: (1) National Sugar Institute (NSI) and Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) are also in Kanpur. (2) Indian Institute of Sugarcane Research (IISR), CDRI, NBRI, and CIMAP are located in Lucknow. (3) Indian Institute of Vegetable Research (IIVR) is in Varanasi. (4) Indian Veterinary Research Institute (IVRI) and Central Avian Research Institute (CARI) are located at Izatnagar, Bareilly.
qe: Where is the Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR) located in Uttar Pradesh?

q:
उत्तर प्रदेश के निम्नलिखित जिलों का उनके आधिकारिक ODOP उत्पादों से मिलान कीजिए:
1. कन्नौज — (i) इत्र
2. भदोही — (ii) कालीन (दरी)
3. वाराणसी — (iii) बनारसी रेशमी साड़ी
4. कानपुर नगर — (iv) चमड़ा उत्पाद
सही कूट चुनिए:
e: Kannauj is known as India's Perfume Capital (Ittar), Bhadohi as 'Carpet City', Varanasi for Banarasi Silk Sarees, and Kanpur Nagar (along with Agra) for Leather Products. | कन्नौज इत्र के लिए, भदोही कालीन के लिए, वाराणसी बनारसी साड़ी के लिए तथा कानपुर चमड़ा उत्पादों के लिए प्रसिद्ध है। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Gorakhpur's ODOP is Terracotta (GI-tagged). (2) Lucknow's ODOP is Chikankari & Zari-Zardozi. (3) Azamgarh (Nizamabad) is famous for Black Pottery (GI-tagged). (4) Khurja (Bulandshahr) is renowned for Ceramic Pottery.
qe:
Match the following districts of Uttar Pradesh with their official ODOP (One District One Product) items:
1. Kannauj — (i) Perfume (Ittar)
2. Bhadohi — (ii) Carpet (Dari)
3. Varanasi — (iii) Banarasi Silk Saree
4. Kanpur Nagar — (iv) Leather Products
Select the correct code:

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के निम्नलिखित अनुसंधान संस्थानों और उनके स्थानों में से कौन-सा सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
o: केंद्रीय आलू अनुसंधान संस्थान परिसर — गोरखपुर
भारतीय चरागाह एवं चारा अनुसंधान संस्थान — झाँसी
e: The Central Potato Research Institute (CPRI) regional campus in Uttar Pradesh is located at Modipuram in Meerut district, not Gorakhpur. | केंद्रीय आलू अनुसंधान संस्थान का क्षेत्रीय परिसर उत्तर प्रदेश के मोदीपुरम (मेरठ) में स्थित है, गोरखपुर में नहीं। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Central Institute for Subtropical Horticulture (CISH) is located at Rehmankhera, Lucknow. (2) Indian Institute of Handloom Technology (IIHT) is in Varanasi. (3) Central Pulp and Paper Research Institute (CPPRI) is located in Saharanpur. (4) National Bureau of Fish Genetic Resources (NBFGR) is situated in Lucknow.
qe: Which of the following research institutes in Uttar Pradesh and its location is NOT correctly matched?
oe: Central Potato Research Institute (regional campus) — Gorakhpur
Indian Grassland and Fodder Research Institute (IGFRI) — Jhansi
Central Institute for Research on Goats (CIRG) — Makhdoom (Mathura)

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के किस स्थान पर राज्य का एकमात्र परमाणु ऊर्जा संयंत्र (Nuclear Power Station) स्थित है?
e: Narora Atomic Power Station (NAPS), located in Bulandshahr district on the banks of the Ganga, is Uttar Pradesh's only nuclear power plant (2 × 220 MW PHWR units). | नरौरा परमाणु ऊर्जा संयंत्र (बुलंदशहर) उत्तर प्रदेश का एकमात्र परमाणु बिजलीघर है। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Obra, Anpara, and Singrauli Super Thermal Power Stations are in Sonbhadra district ('Energy Capital of India'). (2) Harduaganj Thermal Power Station is in Aligarh, Parichha in Jhansi, and Panki in Kanpur. (3) Dadri (Gautam Buddha Nagar) has a major NTPC thermal/gas power plant. (4) UP's first floating solar power plant was established at Rihand Dam (Sonbhadra) and solar park in Bundelkhand (Jalaun/Lalitpur).
qe: Which place in Uttar Pradesh hosts the state's sole Nuclear Power Station?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश रक्षा औद्योगिक गलियारे (UPDIC) में कितने नामित नोड्स (nodes) शामिल हैं?
e: The UP Defence Industrial Corridor (UPDIC), implemented by UPEIDA, has 6 nodes: Agra, Aligarh, Chitrakoot, Jhansi, Kanpur, and Lucknow. | यूपी डिफेंस इंडस्ट्रियल कॉरिडोर में 6 नोड्स हैं—आगरा, अलीगढ़, चित्रकूट, झाँसी, कानपुर और लखनऊ। Exam Booster Facts: (1) BrahMos missile manufacturing facility is established at the Lucknow node of UPDIC. (2) Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL) unit is being developed at the Jhansi node. (3) Adani Defence ammunition complex is located at the Kanpur node. (4) UPEIDA (Uttar Pradesh Expressways Industrial Development Authority) is the nodal agency for both expressways and UPDIC.
qe: The Uttar Pradesh Defence Industrial Corridor (UPDIC) comprises how many designated nodes?

q:
उत्तर प्रदेश के औद्योगिक और खनिज परिदृश्य के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: सोनभद्र जिले के रेणुकूट में भारत के सबसे बड़े एल्युमिनियम संयंत्रों में से एक हिंडाल्को (Hindalco) स्थित है।
कथन II: भारत की पहली चीनी मिल 1903 में उत्तर प्रदेश के देवरिया जिले के प्रतापपुर में स्थापित की गई थी।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
o: न तो कथन I और न ही II
e: Both statements are correct. Hindalco (Aditya Birla Group) operates its mega aluminium plant at Renukoot (Sonbhadra), and India's first modern vacuum-pan sugar mill opened at Pratappur (Deoria) in 1903. | दोनों कथन सही हैं। रेणुकूट (सोनभद्र) में हिंडाल्को का एल्युमिनियम संयंत्र है तथा 1903 में प्रतापपुर (देवरिया) में भारत की पहली चीनी मिल स्थापित हुई थी। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Mathura hosts Uttar Pradesh's only oil refinery (Indian Oil Corporation). (2) IFFCO fertilizer plants in UP are located at Phulpur (Prayagraj) and Aonla (Bareilly). (3) Diesel Locomotive Works (now Banaras Locomotive Works, BLW) is in Varanasi, and Modern Coach Factory is at Lalganj (Raebareli). (4) Churk and Dalla (Sonbhadra) and Chunar (Mirzapur) are major cement hubs.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding Uttar Pradesh's industrial and mineral profile:
Statement I: Renukoot in Sonbhadra district is home to Hindalco, one of India's largest aluminium smelting plants.
Statement II: The first sugar mill in India was established in 1903 at Pratappur in Deoria district of Uttar Pradesh.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के जिलों और उनके जीआई-टैग/ODOP पारंपरिक उत्पादों के निम्नलिखित युग्मों में से कौन-सा सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
e: Chandauli's ODOP is Zari-Zardozi (and it is famously known as the 'Rice Bowl of UP' for Black Rice), whereas brass idols/bell metal are linked to Jalesar (Etah) and Moradabad. | चंदौली का ODOP जरी-जरदोजी है (तथा इसे काला चावल/'धान का कटोरा' के रूप में जाना जाता है), जबकि पीतल घुंघरू/मूर्ति हेतु जलेसर (एटा) प्रसिद्ध है। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Uttar Pradesh holds the highest number of GI-tagged products in India (75+ GI tags). (2) Amroha Dholak, Kalpi Handmade Paper (Jalaun), Mahoba Gaura Patthar, and Baghpat Home Furnishings received GI tags. (3) Banaras Paan, Langra Mango, Ramnagar Bhanta (brinjal), and Adamchini Rice are GI products of the Varanasi region. (4) Mainpuri is famous for Tarkashi art (brass wire inlay on wood).
qe: Which of the following pairs of UP districts and their GI-tagged / ODOP traditional products is NOT correctly matched?

q:
उत्तर प्रदेश के निम्नलिखित एक्सप्रेसवे को उनकी कुल लंबाई के अवरोही क्रम में व्यवस्थित कीजिए:
1. गंगा एक्सप्रेसवे
2. पूर्वांचल एक्सप्रेसवे

e: Exact lengths: Ganga Expressway (594 km) > Purvanchal Expressway (341 km) > Agra–Lucknow Expressway (302 km) > Bundelkhand Expressway (296 km). | लंबाई का अवरोही क्रम: गंगा एक्सप्रेसवे (594 किमी) > पूर्वांचल एक्सप्रेसवे (341 किमी) > आगरा–लखनऊ एक्सप्रेसवे (302 किमी) > बुंदेलखंड एक्सप्रेसवे (296 किमी)। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Gorakhpur Link Expressway (91.35 km) connects Gorakhpur to Purvanchal Expressway at Salarpur (Azamgarh). (2) Yamuna Expressway is 165.5 km long connecting Greater Noida to Agra. (3) Noida International Airport (Jewar, Gautam Buddha Nagar) is being developed as Asia's largest greenfield airport. (4) National Waterway-1 (NW-1) on the Ganga runs from Prayagraj (UP) to Haldia (West Bengal), length 1,620 km.
qe:
Arrange the following operational/under-construction expressways of Uttar Pradesh in descending order of their total length:

2. Purvanchal Expressway

4. Bundelkhand Expressway

q: भारत की संसद में उत्तर प्रदेश के लिए क्रमशः कितनी लोकसभा और राज्यसभा सीटें आवंटित हैं?
e: Uttar Pradesh sends the highest number of parliamentarians to both Houses: 80 members to the Lok Sabha and 31 members to the Rajya Sabha. | उत्तर प्रदेश से संसद में सर्वाधिक 80 लोकसभा सदस्य तथा 31 राज्यसभा सदस्य निर्वाचित होते हैं। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Out of 80 Lok Sabha seats in UP, 17 are reserved for Scheduled Castes (SC) and 0 for ST. (2) Out of 403 Vidhan Sabha seats in UP, 84 are reserved for SC and 2 for ST (Obra and Duddhi in Sonbhadra). (3) UP Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad) has 100 members. (4) Allahabad High Court (established 1866, shifted from Agra in 1869) is India's largest High Court by sanctioned strength, with its bench at Lucknow.
qe: How many Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha seats are allocated to Uttar Pradesh in the Parliament of India respectively?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश बजट 2026–27 का कुल आकार (परिव्यय) कितना है?
e: The total outlay of the Uttar Pradesh Budget 2026–27 is ₹9,12,696 crore, making it the largest state budget in UP's history. | उत्तर प्रदेश बजट 2026–27 का कुल आकार ₹9,12,696 करोड़ है, जो राज्य के इतिहास का सबसे बड़ा बजट है। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Fiscal deficit in UP Budget 2026–27 is targeted at 3% of GSDP (within FRBM norms). (2) Education receives 12.4% of total budget allocation in 2026–27. (3) UP's Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP) is projected at ₹30.25 lakh crore. (4) UP Budget 2026–27 emphasizes youth employment, women empowerment, infrastructure, and rural-agricultural growth.
qe: What is the total size (outlay) of the Uttar Pradesh Budget 2026–27?

q: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार, उत्तर प्रदेश के किस जिले की कुल साक्षरता दर सर्वाधिक है?
e: As per Census 2011, Gautam Buddha Nagar recorded the highest literacy rate in UP (80.12%), followed by Kanpur Nagar (79.65%) and Auraiya (78.95%). | जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार गौतम बुद्ध नगर की साक्षरता दर (80.12%) उत्तर प्रदेश में सर्वाधिक है। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Lowest literacy rate in UP: Shravasti (46.74%), followed by Bahraich and Balrampur. (2) Overall literacy rate of UP (Census 2011): 67.7% (Male: 77.3%, Female: 57.2%). (3) Highest female literacy: Kanpur Nagar (75.05%); lowest female literacy: Shravasti (34.78%). (4) UP's total population (Census 2011): 19.98 crore (16.51% of India's population); most populous district: Prayagraj; least populous: Mahoba.
qe: According to Census 2011, which district of Uttar Pradesh has the highest overall literacy rate?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश बजट 2026–27 के अंतर्गत पुत्री विवाह अनुदान योजना की वित्तीय सहायता राशि बढ़ाकर कितनी कर दी गई है?
e: In UP Budget 2026–27, the daughter marriage grant for eligible families has been raised to ₹1 lakh. | उत्तर प्रदेश बजट 2026–27 में पात्र परिवारों हेतु पुत्री विवाह अनुदान राशि को बढ़ाकर ₹1 लाख किया गया है। Exam Booster Facts: (1) UP Budget 2026–27 also allocates ₹400 crore for the Scooty Scheme for meritorious girl students. (2) Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana provides ₹25,000 in 6 stages from birth to graduation. (3) UP Employment Mission aims to expand formal and self-employment opportunities across the state. (4) Mukhyamantri Abhyudaya Yojana provides free coaching for UPSC, UPPSC, NEET, JEE, and NDA aspirants across UP districts.
qe: Under the Uttar Pradesh Budget 2026–27, the financial grant under the Daughter Marriage Grant Scheme (Mukhyamantri Samuhik Vivah / Kanya Vivah Anudan) has been enhanced to:

q: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार, उत्तर प्रदेश के किस जिले में सर्वाधिक लिंगानुपात (प्रति 1,000 पुरुषों पर महिलाएँ) दर्ज किया गया?
e: Jaunpur recorded the highest sex ratio in Uttar Pradesh (1,024), followed by Azamgarh (1,019) and Deoria (1,017). | जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार जौनपुर में उत्तर प्रदेश का सर्वाधिक लिंगानुपात (1,024) दर्ज किया गया। Exam Booster Facts: (1) UP's overall sex ratio (Census 2011) is 912 (national average 943); child sex ratio (0–6 yrs) is 902. (2) Lowest sex ratio in UP: Gautam Buddha Nagar (851), followed by Baghpat and Hamirpur (861). (3) UP's population density is 829 persons/sq km (highest: Ghaziabad 3,971; lowest: Lalitpur 242). (4) UP's decadal population growth rate (2001–2011) was 20.23%.
qe: According to Census 2011, which district of Uttar Pradesh recorded the highest sex ratio (females per 1,000 males)?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश की किस अनुसूचित जनजाति (ST) की जनसंख्या राज्य में सर्वाधिक है तथा जिसे पारंपरिक रूप से दीपावली को शोक पर्व के रूप में मनाने हेतु जाना जाता है?
e: Tharu is the most populous Scheduled Tribe in Uttar Pradesh (concentrated in the Terai belt—Lakhimpur Kheri, Bahraich, Shravasti, Balrampur, Maharajganj) and is traditionally noted for observing Diwali as a mourning day. | थारू उत्तर प्रदेश की सर्वाधिक जनसंख्या वाली जनजाति है (तराई क्षेत्र में केंद्रित), जो पारंपरिक रूप से दीपावली को शोक पर्व के रूप में मनाती है। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Buksa (Bhoksa) tribe resides primarily in Bijnor district. (2) Mahigir tribe (fishermen community following Islam) is found in Najibabad (Bijnor). (3) Highest ST population district in UP: Sonbhadra; lowest ST population: Baghpat. (4) ST population forms 0.57% of UP's total population (Census 2011), while SC population is 20.7% (highest SC % in Kaushambi, highest SC count in Sitapur).
qe: Which Scheduled Tribe (ST) of Uttar Pradesh has the largest population in the state and is known for celebrating Diwali as a day of mourning (Shok Parva) traditionally?

q: टियर-2 शहरों में IT/ITeS निर्यात को बढ़ावा देने हेतु सॉफ्टवेयर टेक्नोलॉजी पार्क्स ऑफ इंडिया (STPI) का 75वाँ केंद्र उत्तर प्रदेश के किस शहर में स्थापित किया गया?
e: STPI's 75th centre was established in Bareilly, expanding UP's IT and startup ecosystem beyond Noida and Lucknow. | टियर-2 शहरों में आईटी व स्टार्टअप को बढ़ावा देने हेतु STPI का 75वाँ केंद्र बरेली में स्थापित किया गया। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Earlier STPI centres in UP operate in Noida, Lucknow, Prayagraj, Kanpur, Agra, Meerut, Gorakhpur, and Varanasi. (2) UP Budget 2026–27 allocates 12.4% to Education and focuses on digital/AI skill development. (3) Bareilly is also known for Zari-Zardozi (ODOP), IVRI, and Nath Nagari corridor. (4) Lucknow is being developed as India's first 'AI City'.
qe: In which city of Uttar Pradesh was the 75th centre of the Software Technology Parks of India (STPI) established to boost IT/ITeS exports in tier-2 cities?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश की मुख्यमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना तथा मुख्यमंत्री अभ्युदय योजना के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही है?
o: दोनों योजनाएँ केवल औद्योगिक श्रमिकों के लिए हैं
जन आरोग्य फसल बीमा तथा अभ्युदय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन प्रदान करती है
जन आरोग्य निःशुल्क कोचिंग तथा अभ्युदय ₹5 लाख स्वास्थ्य बीमा प्रदान करती है
जन आरोग्य ₹5 लाख स्वास्थ्य बीमा तथा अभ्युदय निःशुल्क प्रतियोगी परीक्षा कोचिंग प्रदान करती है
e: Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Abhiyan extends ₹5 lakh annual cashless health cover to eligible families left out of SECC-2011 Ayushman Bharat, while Mukhyamantri Abhyudaya Yojana offers free coaching for UPSC, UPPSC, JEE, and NEET. | मुख्यमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना पात्र परिवारों को ₹5 लाख का स्वास्थ्य बीमा तथा मुख्यमंत्री अभ्युदय योजना UPSC, UPPSC, JEE, NEET आदि की निःशुल्क कोचिंग देती है। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Mukhyamantri Abhyudaya Yojana was launched in February 2021. (2) Under UP Budget 2026–27, ₹400 crore has been provisioned for the Scooty Scheme for meritorious girl students. (3) UP Employment Mission targets large-scale job creation and skill-to-work placement. (4) Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Rajya Karmachari Cashless Chikitsa Yojana provides cashless healthcare to UP state employees and pensioners.
qe: Which of the following statements regarding the Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Yojana and Mukhyamantri Abhyudaya Yojana of Uttar Pradesh is correct?
oe: Both schemes are exclusively for industrial workers
Jan Arogya provides crop insurance; Abhyudaya provides old-age pension
Jan Arogya provides free coaching; Abhyudaya provides ₹5 lakh health cover
Jan Arogya provides ₹5 lakh health cover; Abhyudaya provides free competitive exam coaching

q:
उत्तर प्रदेश बजट 2026–27 के निम्नलिखित राजकोषीय संकेतकों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: उत्तर प्रदेश का सकल राज्य घरेलू उत्पाद (GSDP) ₹30.25 लाख करोड़ अनुमानित है।
कथन II: राजकोषीय घाटा GSDP के 3% पर लक्षित है तथा कुल व्यय में शिक्षा का हिस्सा 12.4% है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
o: न तो कथन I और न ही II
e: Both statements accurately reflect the verified UP Budget 2026–27 numbers: total budget ₹9,12,696 crore, GSDP ₹30.25 lakh crore, fiscal deficit 3%, and education share 12.4%. | दोनों कथन सही हैं: कुल बजट ₹9,12,696 करोड़, GSDP ₹30.25 लाख करोड़, राजकोषीय घाटा 3% तथा शिक्षा परिव्यय 12.4% है। Exam Booster Facts: (1) Under the FRBM Act, states are generally permitted a fiscal deficit up to 3% of GSDP. (2) Daughter marriage grant has been enhanced to ₹1 lakh in UP Budget 2026–27. (3) ₹400 crore is provisioned for the meritorious girl students' Scooty Scheme. (4) Uttar Pradesh aims to transform into a $1 trillion economy through industrial corridors, MSMEs, and expressway-led logistics.
qe:
Consider the following fiscal indicators of the Uttar Pradesh Budget 2026–27:
Statement I: The Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP) of Uttar Pradesh is estimated at ₹30.25 lakh crore.
Statement II: The fiscal deficit is targeted at 3% of GSDP, and education accounts for 12.4% of total expenditure.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के संवैधानिक और प्रशासनिक इतिहास के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
o: स्वतंत्रता के बाद उत्तर प्रदेश विधानसभा के प्रथम अध्यक्ष गोविंद बल्लभ पंत थे
लखनऊ 1935 में प्रांत की पूर्ण प्रशासनिक राजधानी बना
